evidence.text: autoMEE develops flowMEE, an AI-powered accounting platform that automates document processing, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation and financial workflows for businesses and accounting firms.

editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 用 flowMEE 将文档归集、记账和银行对账接入财务流程。
zh.judgment: 节省价值在少返工的账务闭环，不能只看识别了多少发票。
zh.replaces: 财务团队手工录凭证、分配科目、匹配银行流水并追查差异。
zh.product: 官网列出文档流转、AI 记账、对账及实时损益等模块，并对接会计系统。最终财务责任与监督仍留给用户，自动处理不等于免除复核。
zh.customer: 企业财务负责人、主办会计与会计事务所是明确对象。需求按月持续发生，价值要看每个客户结账工时与复核差错，而不是单纯文档吞吐。
zh.workflow: 原始文档进入流转后按会计科目记账，再与银行数据匹配并回写系统。异常科目、重复凭证和未匹配交易是关键复核点，需要保留来源与审批记录。
zh.business_model: 企业价目列出 starterMEE 每月 985 PLN 加 VAT，optiMEE 2485 PLN 起，包含额度并有超额费用；高阶方案询价。公司与事务所方案不同，价格不能跨方案直接外推。
zh.traction: 官网效果计算器是基于输入假设的销售工具，不是实际客户节省证明。本次未取得独立结账对照或续费数据；界面中的处理数量也不是收入。
zh.moat: 科目规则、会计系统连接与客户历史例外可能产生粘性。通用 OCR 和生成模型较易复制，难点是让账务结果可审计并适配不同机构。
zh.funding_read: 融资可支持产品与客户交付，下一里程碑应是同一事务所在更多客户上复用。扩张是否盈利要扣除配置、复核与例外处理成本。
zh.risks: 科目误分或对账错误可能在月底集中暴露；客户文档质量与规则变化会增加人工。自动化越深，错误传播范围越需要控制。
zh.takeaway: 把识别、记账、对账和人工审批看作同一业务流程。先减少每次结账的复核与返工，再扩大处理量。
zh.watch_next: 看关闭异常所需时间、科目修正率、月结时长和每客户交付成本。区分小企业与会计事务所的客户结构、额度和续费。

en.summary: flowMEE joins document intake, bookkeeping and bank reconciliation in finance workflows.
en.judgment: Value lies in a less error-prone close, not merely more recognized invoices.
en.replaces: Manual journal entry, account assignment, bank matching and exception tracing.
en.product: The site covers document workflows, AI bookkeeping, reconciliation and live financial views, with accounting integrations. Users retain final responsibility and oversight; automation does not remove review.
en.customer: CFOs, chief accountants and accounting firms are stated users. Recurring monthly work supports demand, measured by close effort and correction rates per customer.
en.workflow: Documents move through intake, account assignment and bank matching into existing systems. Unmatched transactions, duplicates and ambiguous accounts require traceable exceptions and approval.
en.business_model: The business page lists starterMEE at PLN985/month plus VAT and optiMEE from PLN2485, with allowances and overage charges; higher tiers use quotes. Firm and business plans differ.
en.traction: The savings calculator is assumption-driven sales material, not measured customer outcomes. Independent close comparisons and renewals were unavailable; interface transaction counts are not revenue.
en.moat: Account rules, system connections and historical exceptions may create continuity. Generic OCR is easier to copy than audit-ready accounting adapted to different organizations.
en.funding_read: Financing can support delivery; reuse across more clients at one accounting firm is a useful milestone. Configuration, review and exception costs must be included in expansion economics.
en.risks: Wrong accounts or matching may surface at month-end. Poor documents and changing rules increase manual work; deeper automation makes error propagation more consequential.
en.takeaway: Treat recognition, bookkeeping, reconciliation and approval as one workflow. Reduce review and rework before maximizing document volume.
en.watch_next: Watch exception resolution, account corrections, close time and cost per client. Separate business and accounting-firm plans, allowances and retention.
